setup.story_en: Jack confidently refuses an umbrella while walking in Gangnam.
setup.visual: Jack strides through busy Gangnam under a darkening sky, waving off Diane's umbrella.

scenes.visual: Jack walking in Gangnam, dark clouds behind him, Diane holding out an umbrella.
scenes.action: Jack waves the umbrella away with a smug grin.

problem.visual: Sky-high wall of rain slams into Gangnam; streets flood in seconds.

scenes.visual: A sudden absurd monsoon hits Gangnam, raindrops the size of fists.
scenes.action: Jack is pelted and keeps walking, pretending it's nothing.

absurd_escalation.story_en: The flooding becomes a cartoon-scale tsunami.
absurd_escalation.visual: A cartoon tsunami towers over the skyscrapers of Seoul with Jack tiny in front of it.

scenes.visual: A towering cartoon tsunami over Gangnam's skyline.
scenes.action: Jack looks up at the wave and gulps.

unexpected_twist.story_en: Korean commuters are still going to work normally, including someone casually commuting by boat.
unexpected_twist.visual: Office workers wade past calmly with briefcases; a man rows a small boat down the flooded street.

scenes.visual: Commuters walk to work through the flood; one man casually paddles a boat.
scenes.action: The boat commuter nods politely at Jack.

resolution.story_en: Jack reaches their hilltop home completely soaked.
resolution.visual: Jack, drenched, trudges up the hill to their home.

scenes.visual: Jack climbs the hill to the house, completely soaked.
scenes.action: Jack arrives at the door dripping like a wet mouse.

product_bridge.story_en: Jack is a walking puddle. Diane refuses to let him drip water inside and throws him a towel.
product_bridge.visual: Diane blocks the doorway and tosses a towel at the puddle that is Jack.

scenes.visual: Diane at the door, Jack a walking puddle on the doorstep.
scenes.action: Diane throws a towel and points at the floor.

lines.speaker: diane
lines.en: Stop! Not one drop inside! Towel!
lines.ko: 거기 서! 한 방울도 안 돼! 수건!
